# TotalVidMem <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
TotalVidMem:Int32
```

**Returns:** The size of the video memory in bytes.

## Description

The total amount of video memory in bytes.

## Differences

* The answer comes from the graphics card and is cut off at 2 GB, because it has to fit into an integer. [TotalVidMem64](TotalVidMem64) is not cut off. It is 0 when no graphics window is open.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
Print "Video memory: " + (TotalVidMem() / 1048576) + " MB"
WaitKey
```
